finding.title: Include descendant mesh output in parent capture bounds

implementation: Retain descendant mesh output and intermediate extents while walking to the capturing group.
Use affine Bezier control hulls and conservative rigid MLS/starch enclosures; keep uniform translations tight.
Apply ancestor effects only at group containers, preserving transform-only parent semantics.
Keep the existing 8192-axis and managed memory limits.
Advance Canvas to 1.47.3 and WebGL2 to 0.68.3; recompute the pinned request fingerprint.
